testSummary.note: Cumulative across V4.1-V5.8. V5.8 added 21 new tests across 4 suites.

supportedClaims: Branch prediction is N-conditioned — global pooled thresholds fail.
d_mean is the strongest practical predictor (richer features add little).
Epoch 5 prediction is highly accurate (bal >= 0.93 for all class-stable N).
N=71 is predictable at epoch 5 (bal = 0.967) — not a forecasting blind spot.
N=64 and N=66 are class-imbalance artifacts — scores are not meaningful.
Train-test gaps are small (< 0.04) — no overfitting evidence.
conditionalClaims: d_mean is the strongest forecasting coordinate among tested features.
Earlier prediction may require richer state representations.
Results based on B0 condition with seeds 0-49/50-99 train/test split.
